title: CVE Intel update - The open-source CVE triage tool.
content_md:
Few week ago I posted CVE Intel here and got really good advice. Thank you all. Here's what's new since then. (original post: https://www.reddit.com/r/cybersecurity/comments/1x8v176/opensource_cve_triage_in_one_place_kev_epss_nvd/ ) Quick what: CVE Intel is an open-source tool that pulls CVE data from NVD, CISA KEV, EPSS, OSV and public exploit sources into one place. It runs as a desktop app, CLI, REST API or MCP server. It can also scan your dependencies, your machine, container images and your own domains. Updates Decisions. Record what you decided about a CVE (patch now, defer, accept the risk, not affected) and the assumptions behind it, like "not in KEV" or "EPSS below X". Every watchlist refresh re-checks them.
